XHelpers Pro 1.0.15 (33)
- Show Claude and Codex usage together in the menu bar, with consistent provider colors and support for saved Codex profiles. - Restore the original display-dimming shortcut and add a separate dimming toggle. - Keep the text editor’s file browser available in every tab of a multi-tab window. - Improve menu state handling when windows change and prevent stale window updates from changing menu selections. - Include the latest shared media updates and approved translations across all 25 supported languages.
